units.source_text: 由于名人患病的消息传到了东京，学艺部长久米才来的吧。

en.t: Because news of the Master's illness had reached Tokyo, Kume, the head of the arts section, must have come.

units.source_text: 弟子前田陈尔六段也来了。

en.t: His disciple, Maeda Chinji, sixth dan, also came.

units.source_text: 列席观战的小野田六段、岩本六段两人，是在八月五日一起到达的。

en.t: Onoda sixth dan and Iwamoto sixth dan, who were present to watch the match, arrived together on August 5.

units.source_text: 连珠棋名人高木在旅行中途顺便也来了一趟。

en.t: Takagi, a master of renju, also stopped by once in the course of his travels.

units.source_text: 正在访问宫下的土居将棋八段也来游学。

en.t: Doi, an eighth dan shogi player who was visiting Miyashita, also came to observe and learn.
The scene around the match was extraordinarily lively.
